clue.text: Electrical topic in this week's magazine

parts.note: electrical flow is current, as in alternating current
a topic under discussion is an issue

explanation.surface: Someone describes an electricity feature appearing in this week's edition of a magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: The latest number of a periodical on the newsstands is the edition now on sale.

clue.text: Machete for a trim young lady

parts.note: to trim is to cut
a lass is a girl or young lady

explanation.surface: A big knife is chosen to give a girl a haircut.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutlass is a short curved sword, a heavy bladed weapon like a jungle knife.

clue.text: I'd relay broadcast without any hesitation

indicators.note: scattered widely, so these letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: A radio operator says they would pass the message on gladly.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something willingly and promptly is doing it with no reluctance.

clue.text: What the locomotive spotter does may impair vision

definitions.text: What the locomotive spotter does may impair vision

parts.note: a spotter watches, that is, eyes things
a locomotive pulls a train

explanation.surface: Peering at engines all day could ruin a trainspotter's sight.
explanation.walkthrough: The spotter EYES the TRAIN, and that is just what causes tired eyes; the clue defines and builds the answer at once.
explanation.definitionFit: Fatigue of the eyes from prolonged peering causes blurred sight.

clue.text: Raised objection to Anglo-Saxon brasses

indicators.note: in a down clue lifted upward means the word is read from the bottom up

parts.note: a but is an objection, as in 'no ifs or buts'

explanation.surface: Someone complains about old English brass ornaments.
explanation.definitionFit: Tubas are large bass instruments in the brass section of a band.

clue.text: Inherit the estate and make a go of things

definitions.meaning: to follow an heir into possession, as a son follows a father

explanation.definitionFit: To follow as heir is one sense, and to prosper or achieve one's aim is the other.

clue.text: Greek character promotes one fellow from London

parts.note: ups means promotes, as in raising a price
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A Greek man advances a colleague who comes from the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'character' means a letter here, not a person; 'fellow from' only links the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Upsilon is the twentieth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: To cultivate a Roman poet proves a trial

parts.note: to court someone is to cultivate their favour
Martial was a Roman poet known for epigrams

explanation.surface: Trying to win over a classical poet turns out to be an ordeal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a trial' reads as an ordeal, but it is the military tribunal.
explanation.definitionFit: A court martial is a military tribunal that judges service personnel.

clue.text: Affront adjutant general in extravagant surroundings

indicators.note: the adjutant general is placed in the middle of the word for extravagant, with 'surroundings' describing that word as the setting

parts.note: outre means extravagant or bizarre
AG is the standard abbreviation for adjutant general

explanation.surface: A senior officer is insulted by being housed in gaudy, over-the-top quarters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surroundings' only describes the setting the officer is put in; outre is a borrowing from French meaning outlandish.
explanation.definitionFit: An affront is an insult that provokes indignation, much like a scandalous offence.

clue.text: Dollar was handed over for a tool

parts.note: buck is slang for a dollar

indicators.note: turned over hand to hand, so the word 'was' is flipped end to end

explanation.surface: Someone paid a dollar in exchange for a piece of equipment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'handed over' looks like payment for the purchase, but it signals turning the word round.
explanation.definitionFit: A bucksaw is a framed saw for cutting logs, a kind of carpentry implement.

clue.text: Gateman who stands looking at a bowler

definitions.meaning: a wicket is a small gate, so its keeper is a gatekeeper

definitions.text: who stands looking at a bowler
definitions.meaning: in cricket the fielder crouched behind the stumps faces the bowler

explanation.walkthrough: The bowler is not a hat but the cricketer delivering the ball; the fielder behind the stumps faces him.
explanation.definitionFit: A keeper of a small gate and the gloved cricket fielder behind the stumps share this name.

clue.text: With regard to a rota, his view is pragmatic

parts.note: re means concerning or with regard to
a rota is a list of duties

explanation.surface: Someone takes a practical line about the office duty roster.
explanation.definitionFit: A person whose outlook is down-to-earth and practical sees things as they are.

clue.text: The woman will get a bill for varnish

parts.note: she will contracts to she'll
an account, abbreviated AC, is a bill

explanation.surface: A lady is presented with an invoice for some wood finish.
explanation.definitionFit: Shellac is a resin dissolved in alcohol and used as a lacquer.

clue.text: Educated man retiring from the club

parts.note: an MA, a Master of Arts, is an educated man
retiring means shy, bashful

explanation.surface: A scholar withdraws from the society he belongs to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the club' sounds like a society, but it is a golf club: a mashy is an old iron, roughly a five-iron.
explanation.definitionFit: A mashy is an old-fashioned golfing iron used for lofted approach shots.

clue.text: Shunning a video can be misconstrued

indicators.note: wrongly interpreted, so these letters are taken in a different order

explanation.surface: Someone warns that refusing to watch a recording may be misread.
explanation.definitionFit: Shunning something means keeping away from it, an act of evasion.

clue.text: Finished plan wins credit

parts.note: something finished is over
a draft is a preliminary plan

explanation.surface: A completed scheme earns praise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'credit' looks like praise but is the bank's sense: borrowing beyond one's balance.
explanation.definitionFit: An overdraft is a bank loan facility letting an account go below zero.

clue.text: Put back the stove

parts.note: the rear is the back
a range is a kitchen stove

explanation.surface: An instruction to move the cooker back into place.
explanation.walkthrough: Moving the stove to the back of the kitchen is rearranging it; 'Put' just links the two halves.
explanation.definitionFit: To shift furniture into new positions is to alter how a room is laid out.

clue.text: A job given to the Italian gospeller

parts.note: a post is a job or position
le is an Italian word for 'the', the feminine plural article

explanation.surface: An Italian preacher is offered a position.
explanation.definitionFit: An apostle was one of the twelve disciples who spread the Christian message.

clue.text: The car trip's cancelled, so get on yer bike

parts.note: a ride is a journey in a vehicle
a cancelled event is off

explanation.surface: The drive is called off, so someone is told to go by bicycle instead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get on yer bike' is a British idiom meaning 'go away' or 'clear off'.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave by riding away matches the brusque command to depart.

clue.text: Nut maybe needed when the battery is flat

definitions.meaning: a nut is an eccentric or obsessive person

definitions.text: needed when the battery is flat
definitions.meaning: a starting handle turned by hand used to start an old car engine without a battery

explanation.definitionFit: An eccentric is called by this word, and so is the starting handle for an engine.

clue.text: First murderer innately suitable to become a master

indicators.note: inborn, within, so the word for suitable is placed in the middle of the murderer's name

parts.note: Cain killed Abel, the first murder in the Bible
apt means suitable

explanation.surface: The Bible's first killer turns out naturally fit to take charge.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship's captain is its master, the commanding officer.

clue.text: One shade thinner

parts.note: an ace counts as one in cards and dice
a tone is a shade of colour

explanation.surface: A paint swatch shows one colour slightly paler than another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thinner' looks like a comparative adjective, but it is a solvent for paint.
explanation.definitionFit: Acetone is a solvent used to dilute paints and remove nail varnish.

clue.text: Appropriate place for freemasons

definitions.meaning: fitting or proper, as in 'a toast is appropriate'
freemasons belong to a fraternal order, so they are within one

explanation.definitionFit: Something fitting is acceptable, and masons are members of a fraternity.

clue.text: Mastermind in charge of Finnish poetry

parts.note: to mastermind an operation is to run it

explanation.surface: A quiz champion takes charge of a Scandinavian poetry evening.
explanation.walkthrough: Old Finnish poems, such as those of the Kalevala, are called runes, so their poetry is described with this adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancient Finnish verse was called runo, so such poetry is described as rune-like.

clue.text: Pete led movement to reduce stocks

indicators.note: the letters of these words are shifted around into a new order

explanation.surface: A man named Pete heads a campaign to run down supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: To exhaust supplies is to use up or drain them.

clue.text: Obstruction by Northern Ireland county causes disappointment

parts.note: in tennis a let is a serve obstructed by the net, and let also means hindrance
Down is one of the six counties of Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: A roadblock in an Ulster county leaves people frustrated.
explanation.walkthrough: LET as obstruction survives in the legal phrase 'without let or hindrance'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that fails to meet expectations is an anticlimax.

clue.text: Nobody but Jack has seafood

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, abbreviated AB for able seaman
nobody but yourself means you are on your own

explanation.surface: Only a sailor gets to eat the shellfish.
explanation.definitionFit: Abalone is an edible sea snail prized as a shellfish delicacy.
